delivery_reference_binding_seam.auth: User Bot token (bf_ prefix, BotKindUser) + ExplicitSpace query/header agreement + Content-Encoding must be empty
delivery_reference_binding_seam.why_current_version_lookup_alone_is_insu: octo-server stores mutable edits in message_extra (version, content_edit, content_edit_hash, revoke, is_deleted) without a per-version historical payload table. Looking up message_id alone returns the current x<version>_<hash> even if a concurrent edit occurred between WKSocket delivery and server lookup, which would bind a pre-edit frame to post-edit metadata (or vice versa).

required_trusted_ingress_evidence.channel_id: physical channel identifier from WKSocket frame
required_trusted_ingress_evidence.message_id: positive int64 decimal string from WKSocket frame
required_trusted_ingress_evidence.message_seq: positive uint32 decimal string (> 0) from WKSocket frame
required_trusted_ingress_evidence.from_uid: sender UID observed on WKSocket frame
required_trusted_ingress_evidence.observed_payload_sha256: 64-hex lowercase SHA-256 computed by the endpoint over the exact raw payload bytes received on the WKSocket frame before any body parsing/release
required_trusted_ingress_evidence.expected_native_version: optional candidate x<version>_<hash> token if already held by caller

verification_and_refusal_rules.mirror_lag: message row absent from sharded message table (not yet persisted or no_persist)
verification_and_refusal_rules.expired_reference: message.is_deleted != 0, message.expire > 0 && now.Unix() - int64(message.expire) >= message.timestamp (read-time TTL expiry), message_extra.revoke != 0, message_extra.is_deleted != 0, thread status == 3, or group missing/disabled
verification_and_refusal_rules.parent_unavailable: thread parent group missing or not in Normal/Disband status
verification_and_refusal_rules.identity_mismatch: stored from_uid != request.from_uid or stored message_seq != request.message_seq
verification_and_refusal_rules.payload_digest_mismatch: SHA-256 of current effective stored payload (content_edit when edited, else message.payload) != request.observed_payload_sha256 (concurrent edit race or content mismatch)
verification_and_refusal_rules.visibility_denied: known space mismatch (!MessageSpaceUnknown && !MessageSpaceExact) or !BotCurrentRead (visibles exclusion, per-user delete, channel offset clear, or bot not active member)
verification_and_refusal_rules.predicate_unsupported: foreign DM channel (dmPeer mismatch) or missing sender user row

non_fabrication_guarantees: Zero message, quote, or media body bytes are ever returned in bound or refused responses

TTL-expired messages (message.expire > 0 && now.Unix() - int64(message.expire) >= message.timestamp) are refused in bind_delivery and returned as unavailable (reason=expired_reference) in resolve, history_headers, and history_disclosure, never issuing a disclosure permit

Cross-space messages (!MessageSpaceExact or !MessageSourceExact) and untagged DMs (MessageSpaceUnknown) are returned as unavailable in history_headers and history_disclosure without leaking cross-space headers or issuing permits

Group and thread deliveries without a visibles exclusion list bot_original_visible and caller_original_visible in unknown_predicates (resolvable_purposes: ["reply"]) and never fabricate original visibility as true
Untagged DM deliveries (payload.space_id == "") list message_space_exact in unknown_predicates (resolvable_purposes: []) and never fabricate DM space membership as true
Two-step history disclosure (history_headers -> history_disclosure) is preserved; no atomic header+body substitute is activated

own_session_repeatable_read.mechanism: SQLNativeFactAdapter.Read and SQLNativeFactAdapter.BindDeliveredMessage attach the caller's RepeatableRead *dbr.Tx to context via withFactReadTx(ctx, tx, a.testNoLocks); ServerMessageFactProvider executes all message, message_extra, message_user_extra, channel_offset, channel_setting, group, group_member, thread, user, and permit queries on that same *dbr.Tx with FOR SHARE NOWAIT

restart_durable_permit_ledger.mechanism: When DurablePermitLedger is enabled (ServerMessageFactConfig.DurablePermitLedger or OCTO_PERMISSION_BUNDLE_DURABLE_PERMIT_LEDGER=true), readHistoryDisclosure verifies evalScopeBaseFacts and storedEpoch == contextEpoch before calling IssueHistoryDisclosureV1, which records issued permits in bot_permission_disclosure_permit (ServerDisclosurePermitDDL) and refuses to re-issue consumed permits; ConsumeDisclosurePermit / ConsumeDisclosurePermitContext atomically sets consumed_at WHERE consumed_at IS NULL (requiring RowsAffected == 1), surviving process restarts
restart_durable_permit_ledger.residual: Live production DB migration for bot_permission_disclosure_permit is out of scope of this slice; when DurablePermitLedger is false, single-use tracking falls back to the in-process usedPmt map

endpoint_responsibilities: Compute observed_payload_sha256 over raw WKSocket frame payload bytes before releasing any message/quote/media content to agent context

Call POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1/bind-delivery?space_id=<space_id> with operation=bind_delivery and message_seq > 0; parse authorities as a 2-element array and binding.proven_predicates as a boolean map

Call POST /v1/bot/permission-facts/v1?space_id=<space_id> using schema-pinned operation=resolve | history_headers | history_disclosure with 32-hex request_id/context_id and decimal-string context_epoch
In disclose(), validate primary.permit against #/$defs/Token (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,512}$; octo-server emits a 43-character raw base64url HMAC-SHA256 string without a 'pmt1-' prefix)

In publish and refuse, check resolved.reference and require every boolean predicate in resolved.predicates (including bot_current_send, bot_group_active_member, dm_bot_to_human_send_relation, dm_human_blocks_bot_clear, message_version_exact) to be true before sending

Enforce fail-closed DENY with zero body release whenever bind-delivery returns status=refused (including reason=expired_reference) or resolve/history_headers/history_disclosure returns status=unavailable
